author_dependency_runtime.rule: Do not call either available runtime an exact author-runtime reproduction. Such a claim requires separately pinned available author builds and the same bounded source/native qualification. No installation or environment change is authorized by this plan.

stages.name: Independent source and custody review
actions: Verify complete source packet and actual driver/instrumentation hashes before numerical imports
Confirm native classes match author AST and boundary layout/model-owner source
Review exact raw-feature/native-edge preprocessing and compact role/input bindings; do not execute author main/eval because they read TEST
Approve prospective fixed tolerances and whole-process resource cap; no numeric discrepancy has been observed in this preparation

stages.name: Complete-graph member function and gradient parity
actions: Compare native and identity boundary full FP32 logits in both local/global stages with identical initial parameters and copied biases
On actual stem Rademacher/S1 initialization, compare all4 boundary functions to separately materialized native member references; global reductions run over each full node set, never member-mixed
Check shared-W gradient equals mean of transformed independent-reference gradients, private R/S/B chain-rule gradients and copied native biases; exact dormant-owner removal/optimizer membership
Use eval-mode gradient parity to remove dropout sampling ambiguity; separately qualify real train-mode dropout/update and RNG replay
Record all local hidden/GAT scores and global Q/K/V,KV,K-sum/denominator shapes and finiteness; private member activations, shared parameter ownership

stages.name: Meaningful real update and local-to-global restoration
actions: For native seeds0..3 and GNNM4, execute two full-graph local FIT updates with actual VAL checks, no TRAIN-control predictions or TEST labels

Retain actual selected local image; independently perturb a scratch live clone with one further real update to make rollback nontrivial, then verify exact model/Adam tensors, optimizer step counters and _global=false restore

Preserve end-of-local RNG at stage transition, set all native/wrapper flags true, execute at least one complete full-graph global FIT update including active gradient checks and all-member connectivity
Short qualification transition is explicitly after the bounded probe local count; it proves mechanics, not completion of source200-local/2500-global schedule

Check strict selector does not reset across transition, earliest ties, first update eligibility and local-best final checkpoint restoration using fixed source/metadata selector fixtures; never introduce a control-based selection

stages.name: Portable serialized exact next-step replay in both stages
actions: Save safe full state including _global, modules/modes, gradients/requires_grad, all model+Adam tensors, exact parameter ownership and Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG

Freshly construct and weights_only-load; require full node FP32 logits within fixed gate before pooling; same-runtime deterministic next real FIT update against preserved live clone must match loss and full post-step logical bytes exactly
Verify RNG replay and source transition RNG-preservation are distinct operations; test final selected local flag even after global work
Retain failure diagnostics and costs; do not deserialize old scientific checkpoints or use probe weights to initialize study fits

stages.name: Measured resource and exact seed/role scope
actions: Measure actual complete native and GNNM4 local/global train+VAL update peaks, full four-member inference, CPU model/Adam snapshot, save/load and simultaneous live/replay clone peaks

Bind all3 exact existing role/TRAIN/VAL source identities and preprocessing row order; explicitly numerically tested block0 only, target blocks1/2 authorized by reviewed exact coverage and normal every-fit validity guards

Estimate full study from200+2500 stage-specific measured update+VAL cost, bounded selection checkpoint IO up to2700 candidates per fit and all15 distinct physical fits; no measured completion or feasibility claim follows from Photo times
Root independently approves whole-process caps and resource forecast before the full study; no launch, retry or install follows automatically from qualification passage

fixed_tolerances.portable_same_runtime_next_step: Bitwise logical-byte equality of dtype/shape/loss/model/Adam/mutable/RNG/gradient/permission/modes state; no approximate replacement

labels_and_work_disclosure: Future role derivation decodes compact official TRAIN labels, including control membership labels; FIT alone supervises updates and VAL selects. Qualification never computes control predictive outcomes or reads TEST labels. Probe updates/replays are additional charged engineering work, not scientific fits.
